abstract: Embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells provide a caricature of pluripotent embryonic stem (ES) cells and may be used as surrogates for investigating the mechanisms that regulate cell differentiation during embryonic development. NTERA-2 is a human EC cell line that differentiates in response to retinoic acid yielding cells that include terminally differentiated neurons. The expression of genes known to be involved in the formation of the vertebrate nervous system was examined during retinoic acid-induced NTERA-2 differentiation. Differentiation of these human EC cells into neurons could be divided into three sequential phases. During phase 1, in the first week of differentiation, hath1 mRNA showed a small transient increase that correlated with the rapid accumulation of nestin message, a marker of neuroprogenitors. Transcripts of nestin were quickly downregulated during phase 2 as expression of neuroD1, characteristic of neuroprogenitors exiting the cell cycle, was induced. A neural cell surface antigen, detected by the monoclonal antibody A2B5, was expressed by cells exiting the cell cycle, correlating with the expression of neuroD1 as the cells became post-mitotic. Markers of mature neural cells (e.g. synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase) were subsequently increased during phase 3 and were maintained. This regulated pattern of gene expression and commitment to the neural lineage indicates that differentiation of NTERA-2 neurons in vitro follows a similar pathway to that observed by neural ectodermal precursors during vertebrate neurogenesis in vivo.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌（EC）細胞は、胚性幹（ES）細胞の簡易モデルであり、発生過程における細胞分化を制御する仕組みを調べる代替モデルとして用いられる。NTERA-2はレチノイン酸に応答して終末分化ニューロンを含む細胞へ分化するヒトEC細胞株である。レチノイン酸誘導分化中に、脊椎動物の神経系形成に関与する遺伝子の発現を調べた。ヒトEC細胞のニューロンへの分化は、3つの連続した段階に分けられた。分化1週目の第1段階では、hath1 mRNAが一過性にわずかに増加し、神経前駆細胞のマーカーであるnestinの転写産物が急速に蓄積した。第2段階では、nestinの転写産物は速やかに減少し、細胞周期を抜け出す神経前駆細胞に特徴的なneuroD1の発現が誘導された。神経細胞表面抗原A2B5は、細胞が細胞周期を離脱しポストミトティックになるにつれて、neuroD1の発現と相関して細胞周期を離脱する細胞で発現した。成熟神経細胞のマーカー（例：synaptophysinやneuron-specific enolase）は第3段階で増加し、その後も維持された。この調節された遺伝子発現パターンと神経系譜へのコミットメントは、NTERA-2ニューロンのin vitroでの分化が、脊椎動物の神経発生in vivoにおいて神経外胚葉前駆細胞が辿る経路と類似していることを示している。
